projects.title: Checkout Flow Redesign
projects.summary: Rebuilt a leaky checkout into a flow people actually finish.
projects.quote: I just wanted to pay — why is this so hard?
projects.body:
## What was broken
Users were abandoning checkout at the payment step. Session recordings showed confusion around hidden fees and a form that punished mistakes.

## Research voices
We interviewed 14 recent abandoners and shadowed 6 live sessions. The pattern was clear: trust collapsed at the moment costs changed.

## What I changed
A single-page flow with upfront cost transparency, inline validation that forgives, and a progress system that never lies about how many steps remain.

## Results
Completion up 31%, drop-offs down 26%, and an NPS jump of 34 points within two months of launch.

## Learnings
Transparency beats persuasion. Every dark pattern we removed improved conversion.

projects.title: Retro Pop Design System
projects.summary: A token-driven system with personality — colored shadows and all.
projects.quote: Finally, a system that doesn't look like every other system.
projects.body:
## What was broken
Five products, five button styles, zero shared language.

## What I changed
Built a token architecture, documented 60+ components with accessibility notes, and shipped Figma libraries wired to code.

## Results
Feature teams ship UI 3x faster and design reviews dropped from hours to minutes.

projects.title: Interaction Motion Reel
projects.summary: Micro-interactions that make products feel alive.
projects.body:
## The work
A collection of shipped micro-interactions: spring-physics toggles, optimistic loading states, and celebratory moments that respect prefers-reduced-motion.

## Results
Measured engagement lift of 12% on flows where motion communicates state.
